newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Citra Marga confirms rights issue.
newsitem.headline: Citra Marga confirms rights issue.

text.p: Toll road operator Citra Marga Nusaphala said it was planning a rights issue soon.
A company official confirmed rumours floating in the market that the company planned a rights issue but declined to give details.
Citra Marga was up about 5.6 percent to 2,350 rupiah in active trading in the afternoon on the talk of the issue and expectations that its first quarter earnings would be positive.
The company official, who spoke on condition of anonymity, declined to comment on the first quarter results.
On Wednesday, the counter closed 25 rupiah higher at 2,225 rupiah on heavy buying of 6.2 million shares, brokers said.
